gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-doto: Bruno Ace looks like glass tubing bent into letters, a ruler-drawn line of constant width with counters that stay open to the outside. Doto is the plain sans partner, with generous space around each glyph.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-electrolize: Expressive and a bit odd, Bruno Ace draws every stroke like a bent paperclip, with no swelling anywhere. Electrolize follows with an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers, keeping things modern.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-elms-sans: Bruno Ace lingers on each character, one beat per letter, drawn with a ruler-straight line and counters that open outward. Elms Sans is the plain sans, a ballpoint-like line.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-encode-sans: Distinctive from the first glyph, Bruno Ace keeps its thin joins exactly as stout as its stems, with counters left open to the outside. Encode Sans is the plain sans below, its gaps keeping c from turning into o.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-encode-sans-expanded: Distinctive and a little theatrical, Bruno Ace turns its curves at the corners with no pressure swell at all, one character per beat. Encode Sans Expanded matches that with c shapes whose tips are pulled well apart.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-encode-sans-sc: Encode Sans SC brings a shallow terminal curl and a wide gap, professional and neutral in tone. Bruno Ace above it holds a gentle monotone of line thickness, so a longer passage should move along smoothly.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-encode-sans-semi-con: Bruno Ace looks like letters bent from a single length of wire, with counters that stay open to the outside. Encode Sans Semi Condensed brings approachable openness on the s, and that open quality is what the two share.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-encode-sans-semi-exp: Bruno Ace keeps a thickness that never changes with direction, and its lingering rhythm gives each character its own beat. Bruno Ace is the expressive voice here, while Encode Sans Semi Expanded is the plain sans, with rounded letters left open.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-exo: Expressive and distinctive, Bruno Ace keeps horizontals as thick as verticals. Exo, a sans with approachable, wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, sits quietly under that ruler-drawn line and lets it lead.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-exo-2: Exo 2 has curves with plenty of daylight inside, clean and professional in feel. Bruno Ace is the rope-thin outline above it, and Exo 2 should read smoothly across a longer passage.
